entities.name: Table T1 – Two-week net buying and selling of Industrials
entities.brief: Two-week net flows of Industrials stocks (2008-2025)
entities.description: Highlights volatility and a near-record $2bn inflow in mid-2025

properties.table_content:
| Year | Approx. Two-Week Net Flow Range ($mn) | Observation |
|---|---|---|
| 2008 | $(1,000) to +500 | Mixed flows, fluctuating around zero |
| 2009 | $(700) to +200 | Generally negative bias |
| 2010 | $(500) to +500 | Mixed flows |
| 2011 | $(800) to +600 | Mixed flows |
| 2012 | $(800) to +700 | Mixed flows |
| 2013 | $(800) to +700 | Mixed flows |
| 2014 | $(800) to +1,200 | Notable positive spikes |
| 2015 | $(1,500) to +1,900 | Historic peak (+1,900mn) in early 2015, followed by negative flows |
| 2016 | $(1,500) to +200 | Predominantly negative flows |
| 2017 | $(1,000) to +500 | Mixed flows, slightly negative bias |
| 2018 | $(2,000) to +1,000 | Wider fluctuations, strong positive flows |
| 2019 | $(1,500) to +1,000 | Mixed flows |
| 2020 | $(1,500) to +800 | Mixed flows, negative during market downturn |
| 2021 | $(2,000) to +1,200 | Strong positive and negative swings |
| 2022 | $(2,000) to +1,600 | Significant positive peaks |
| 2023 | $(1,500) to +800 | Mixed flows |
| 2024 | $(1,500) to +1,000 | Mixed flows |
| 2025 (YTD) | $(1,000) to +2,000 | Near-record inflows (approx. +2,000mn) |
properties.key_insight: Near-record two-week inflow of around $2,000mn in mid-2025, the second-largest since early 2015
